description: Tag or untag email messages with master categories (those created via `manage-category`). action=`set` (default) replaces the message's category set with the supplied `categories` array. action=`add` appends categories to whatever's already on the message. action=`remove` removes only the named categories, leaving the rest. Accepts either `messageId` (single) or `messageIds` (batch via Graph `$batch`). `categories` are matched by display name — names must already exist in the master list (create via `manage-category` first). Returns per-message confirmation.

action.description: set (replace all), add (append), remove (remove specific). Default: set

messageIds.description: Array of message IDs to categorise (batch operation)

name: apply-category
